remarks: Welcome to your dream estate nestled at the quiet cul-de-sac's end in the prestigious Oak Tree Estates neighborhood. Built by Manning Homes, this stunning 3,839 sq ft single-family residence perfectly balances grand architectural scale with warm, functional living. From the moment you step through the front doors, soaring cathedral ceilings and an abundance of natural light establish a breathtaking first impression. The heart of the home features a gourmet chef’s kitchen equipped with a massive granite center island, perfect for casual dining and seamless entertaining.
